title: A verified two-carrier superposition gate
analyticalQuestion: Can the R0.72O full-superposition enhanced-dissipation gate be verified for a genuine two-carrier class, and where does its uniform Morse certificate fail?
supportedTakeaway: For the declared (R, 2R) affine-row family with B=2 and a fixed nonzero coefficient cone inside |lambda|<=1/8, the full shear has a uniform two-critical-point Morse geometry and the R0.72O conditional physical ledger becomes proved. The exact time-slice Morse wall is |lambda|=exp(3y)/4. Nothing here proves an arbitrary multi-carrier theorem.
analyticClaims: On the affine residue row, each positive/negative shift pair contributes 2 cos(m phi), and the declared epsilon absorbs this factor. B=2 does not cancel the signed-shift factor. The resulting full shear is W(y,phi)=exp(-y)cos(phi)+lambda exp(-4y)cos(2phi).
For |lambda|<=1/8, 1+4lambda exp(-3y)cos(phi) lies in [1/2,3/2], so the critical set is exactly {0,pi} for 0<=y<=1.
The shape constants r=pi/4, C0=144, and C1=12 are uniform over the safe cone.
The exact time-slice Morse wall is |lambda|=exp(3y)/4; |lambda|=1/4 is the first wall on the full interval.
After the small-nu Coble--He estimate and the compact-epsilon contraction completion, one pair of ED constants works for every epsilon>=1 in the declared class.

With N=2, B=2, and p=1/sqrt(2), the exact physical ledger retains L_(R,epsilon)^2. Under fixed-polynomial coupling, L_(R,epsilon) is comparable to 1+log R, so the displayed 2^(-2/3) R^(4/3) (1+log R)^2 curve is only an asymptotic representative, with theorem and comparability constants suppressed.
finiteDiagnostics: The source scaffold plots only exact formula evaluations.
Runtime producer, independent, and crosscheck files gate lineage but are not interpolated into a theorem curve.
Temporary or unsealed crosschecks are rejected; formal sealing binds report/audit blobs to the source commit and runtime certificate blobs to the certificate commit.

The five runtime certificate JSON files must belong to the canonical flat certificate directory and be covered by its unique sorted digest-correct SHA256SUMS; the ledger itself is bound to the certificate commit.

Formal plot and manifest runs reject tracked or staged Git drift, record verifiedTrackedTreeClean=true, and bind every figure source blob to the figure-build certificate commit; untracked generated outputs are allowed.
Any later finite diagnostic must be explicitly marked finite-only and cannot set an absolute theorem threshold.
No PDE evolution, regression, fit, or inferred exponent is run by the figure package.

panelClaims.A: The physical two-carrier row reduces exactly to the displayed full profile: paired signed shifts give a factor 2 and the definition of epsilon absorbs it; time slices are direct evaluations.
panelClaims.B: The safe-cone bracket stays positive, hence the critical set is fixed and the declared shape constants are uniform.
panelClaims.C: The exact Morse wall bounds applicability of this certificate, not enhanced dissipation itself.
panelClaims.D: The R0.72O conditional p-ledger is promoted to a theorem only for the declared R0.72P class; open and filled marks share the same fixed-polynomial-coupling representative values, while the exact ledger retains L_(R,epsilon).

renderPolicy.proved: blue solid line or filled circle
renderPolicy.applicabilityBoundary: ochre solid boundary with light fill

claimBoundary: The proved statement is restricted to two carriers (R,2R), B=2, a fixed nonzero lambda cone inside |lambda|<=1/8, one orthogonal affine residue row, and the inherited exact-root-corrected triangular 2.5D family. It does not prove arbitrary-N or arbitrary-p enhanced dissipation, a general common-band theorem, multiscale absorption, a general three-dimensional continuation criterion, finite-time singularity, or global Navier-Stokes regularity.
